channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Trump joins ‘Quad’ summit for first leaders’ meeting in two years
item.description: In a win for Japan, the grouping expressed "grave concerns" about economic coercion, including arbitrary export restrictions.

item.title: Japan to make teaching licenses easier to obtain
item.description: The proposal is designed to make teaching licenses easier to obtain and increase the number of applicants.

item.title: Japan space probe changes target over engine trouble
item.description: The Hayabusa-2 probe brought back pristine materials from the asteroid Ryugu in 2020, supporting discoveries linked to clues on the origin of life.

item.title: New biography of WWII admiral sets out to show his life story as a whole
item.description: Ronald Drabkin's biography of Japanese World War II admiral Isoroku Yamamoto, which came out in print on Nov. 17, examines his strategy, as well as his background, which influenced it.

item.title: Imran Khan seeks urgent medical care fearing he 'may not return alive'
item.description: Pakistan's ex-prime minister, who has been in prison since August 2023, says he has been denied justice.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
